blocks.text: 3772 OLD CLAYBURN ROAD Abbotsford East Abbotsford V3G 1J2

parts.t: Charming 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Split level family home in the heart of Abbotsford! Over 1,838 sqft of bright living space, featuring new floors throughout, a cozy gas fireplace, and fenced yard! The open layout is perfect for entertaining, with spacious bedrooms upstairs, including a master with ensuite. Located just blocks from Sandhill Elementary, Abbotsford Christian School, and Robert Bateman Secondary. Perfect for outdoor relaxation. don’t miss this fantastic opportunity!           Accepted offer subject free, rescission date October 29. Open house cancelled. House can still be shown in case buyers rescind.
